title: Decode a bounded little-endian field
description: Implement int read_le16(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, size_t offset, uint16_t *out).
prompt:
Implement int read_le16(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, size_t offset, uint16_t *out).
Decode two bytes at offset into out and return 1. If fewer than two bytes remain, return 0 and leave out unchanged. buf may be NULL when len is zero; out is always valid.

tests.name: Decode at offset
Truncated field
Overflowing offset
Maximum field

rubric: Respect the stated contract and bounds.
Explain integer widths, ownership, and relevant edge cases.
Separate host-test evidence from hardware guarantees.
follow_ups: Which boundary conditions would you test on the target?
What changes if the function is called from an ISR?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
